subject: PO requirements / invoice cadence and discount eligibility
messages:
From: Marco Rossi <procurement@mercatosys.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: Finance Ops <finance.ops@mercatosys.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 08:13:00 -0400
Subject: PO requirements + invoicing cadence (Mercato)

Hi Lauren,

Quick summary from procurement side — before we can finalize the PO for the RDW-8421 commitment we need a couple of firm confirmations from Redwood: 

- PO number must appear on every invoice and on each line item (our AP system enforces matching).
- We can accept a consolidated monthly invoice for all usage, but the invoice must include your SKU mapping to our internal charge codes.
- Standard net terms are net45 for our vendors; shorter terms require finance approval.
- We run invoice batches weekly; an alternate monthly consolidated invoice is acceptable if you confirm line-level detail.
- We require vendor tax ID and W-9 (or equivalent).

Also attached is our internal PO spec (Mercato_PO_spec.pdf) — it lists the required invoice fields and the exact CSV format our ERP expects.

On discounts: procurement can route an accelerated discount if Redwood can provide a single consolidated invoice and include a monthly forecast commitment (so we can justify earlier payment). What I don’t have is a breakdown from your side about how discount slabs will be applied if invoices are split versus consolidated. Can your team confirm: 1) whether consolidated monthly invoicing keeps the same discount eligibility as milestone/prepaid options; 2) what the discount ladder looks like for quarterly committed spend vs. month-to-month usage?

Can you share a short response today? We need the PO in our system by EOD Wednesday to meet the April payment cycle.

Thanks,
Marco

Marco Rossi
Head of Procurement — Mercato Systems
procurement@mercatosys.com
Attachment: Mercato_PO_spec.pdf (PDF, 93KB)
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Marco Rossi <procurement@mercatosys.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements + invoicing cadence (Mercato)

Marco — thanks for the clear spec and the tight timeline. Very workable; below are the points and our proposals so legal/procurement can align quickly.

1) PO & invoice fields
- We can include the PO number on every invoice and on each line item.
- We’ll add a SKU-to-charge-code mapping table on the invoice and can also provide a CSV that matches your ERP sample.
- Will attach Redwood tax info + W-9 in a follow-up email to Finance Ops.

2) Invoice cadence & discount eligibility
- Consolidated monthly invoice: qualifies for standard commitment discounts (we apply the same slabing whether you invoice consolidated monthly or via multiple weekly invoices, provided the invoice metadata matches our reconciliation rules).
- Split/weekly invoices: to keep discount eligibility intact we need the same consolidated reporting (the sum for the month must map to the same commitment ID). If your AP system can accept a monthly summary CSV tied to the weekly invoices, that preserves the slab.

3) Net terms & discount tradeoffs
- Default offer for RDW-8421: 2.0% discount if net30 + monthly consolidated invoice AND a minimum quarterly commitment (we typically use 60% of the Q forecast as the gating threshold).
- If Mercato needs net45, we can offer 1.0% discount on the same commitment profile.
- Alternatively, a 1.25% discount is available for net60 if prepaid for the month ahead.

4) Next steps and asks
- Can you confirm whether Finance can run a net30 exception if we agree to the 60% quarterly prepay holdback? That would let us keep the 2% slab.
- Please share the exact PO template URL (DocuSign link) and any preferred field names so Ben can map pricing lines to your CSV.
- I’m attaching a short mutual action plan draft to capture these tradeoffs and timelines.

Ben (CC) — can you review the discount ladder above and confirm whether pricing tolerance exists to accept the 60% prepay gating?
Vanessa — can you loop Legal on the PO wording re: invoice aggregation and prepayment language?

I’m available for a 30-minute call this week to walk procurement through the CSV example and the quick reconciliation we’ll need on your side. Proposed: Fri Apr 2 at 5:30pm ET or Mon Apr 5 10am ET — pick what works.

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Head of Customer Success — Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0191
Attachment: Draft-MutualActionPlan.docx (DOCX, 42KB)
From: Marco Rossi <procurement@mercatosys.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: Finance Ops <finance.ops@mercatosys.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 13:44:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements + invoicing cadence (Mercato)

Thanks Lauren — helpful. A few clarifications from Finance: 

- Finance confirmed they can approve net30 for strategic vendors if there is a contractual commitment that reduces our cash exposure (hence the 60% quarterly holdback suggestion). We need that spelled out in the PO and SOW.
- DocuSign template: https://docusign.com/templates/mercato-po-template-id-77 (this is the one our AP team will accept; if you can output a sample invoice that validates against the CSV fields we’ll run it through our ERP sandbox).
- We prefer a single consolidated invoice per month for easier matching. If you must submit weekly invoices, include a monthly summary CSV (field name: monthly_commitment_id) tying all lines to the same commitment.

On discounts — procurement is comfortable moving an accelerated approval to Finance if you can: 
- Share a short example invoice + CSV by EOD Monday that maps to the DocuSign template.
- Confirm Redwood’s tax id and remit address (we need to send them to AP for vendor setup).

If you can get those items to me, I’ll push for a net30 approval and get the PO into the system by Wednesday. Otherwise we’ll process under net45 with the 1.0% slab.

Appreciate the speed —
Marco

Great — thanks for the fast turnaround Marco. Summarizing agreed next steps so nothing falls through the cracks: 

Action items:
- Ben Carter (pricing) to confirm final discount tolerance and produce a sample invoice + CSV that validates against Mercato template — target: Mon Apr 5 EOD.
- Vanessa Ortiz (legal/ops) to review PO wording for the 60% prepay holdback carveout and the monthly_commitment_id field — target: Tue Apr 6 morning.
- Lauren to share Redwood tax ID, remit address, and the W-9 to Finance Ops now (will send separate secure message).
- Marco to load the DocuSign PO template into your ERP sandbox and confirm the field names are unchanged — target: Tue Apr 6.

If all items complete, procurement to approve a net30 exception and Redwood to get the 2.0% discount for the quarter; fallback: net45 with 1.0% if any item misses the timeline.

I’ll hold the proposed 30-minute slot Mon Apr 5 10am ET for a walk-through unless you prefer Fri at 5:30pm. Please confirm which you prefer.

Thanks again — moving quickly here will help both teams hit April close.

Lauren
